note: Status of the 57 R0 stories at the commit named by asOf, recomputed by the M2 milestone gate (docs/m2-alignment-review.md, sections 1 and 7). scripts/uat-trace.mjs enforces DONE, DONE_PENDING_ENV and DONE_UNCONFIRMED: every acceptance id of such a story must be named in a live test title. A DONE_PENDING_ENV story may list in externalChecks the ids that only an external system can prove (or a document review); the gate refuses an external check on any other status, on an unknown id, on an id that a live test now names and on an empty description. PARTIAL and NOT STARTED stories are listed so that the table is complete; the gate does not enforce them. A story moves to DONE only when the gate passes for it.
